canonical.definition: DRYCORE is the ELIMFILTERS air-dryer filtration architecture for moisture control in pneumatic brake systems.
canonical.systems: Air Intake & Airflow Protection; compressed-air and pneumatic brake-system protection.
canonical.failure_impact: Inadequate moisture control in compressed-air circuits can allow condensation to affect valves, actuators and other pneumatic components, reducing braking-system reliability.
canonical.related_standards: Applicable compressed-air and vehicle-system requirements must be selected for the approved application; no universal certification claim is implied by the technology name alone.
canonical.related_technologies: DRYCORE protects a pneumatic compressed-air pathway and must not be represented as an engine-air or cabin-air filtration substitute.
canonical.industrial_role: DRYCORE provides the moisture-control layer for pneumatic brake-system air within ELIMFILTERS Air Intake & Airflow Protection. Selection is governed by compressor duty, moisture exposure, airflow, purge behavior, capacity and service interval.

citation.concept: HYDROCORE Standard Fuel Water Separation Technology

canonical.definition: HYDROCORE is the ELIMFILTERS fuel/water separation architecture for approved standard non-turbine separator filters, including drain and transparent-bowl configurations.
canonical.systems: Fuel Cleanliness Protection; approved standard non-turbine fuel/water separator applications. FH and FG turbine-style systems are excluded � governed exclusively by TURBOCORE� (FUEL_TURBINE family).
canonical.failure_impact: Inadequate water separation or incorrect drainage can allow water to reach downstream injectors and high-pressure pumps, increasing erosion, corrosion and cavitation risk.
canonical.related_standards: Applicable fuel-water separation test methods, water-holding capacity and application requirements must be selected for the approved separator. The technology name alone does not imply a universal efficiency or certification claim.
canonical.related_technologies: SYNTAPORE governs plain diesel-fuel particulate filtration. TURBOCORE exclusively governs FH and FG turbine-style fuel/water separator systems (FUEL_TURBINE family). HYDROCORE ES9 governs standard spin-on separators with drain or transparent bowl (FUEL_WATER_SEPARATOR family). HYDROCORE must never be assigned to FH or FG.
canonical.industrial_role: HYDROCORE provides the standard non-turbine fuel/water separation layer of ELIMFILTERS Fuel Cleanliness Protection.

citation.concept: INTEKCORE Air Cleaner Housing and Sealing Technology

canonical.definition: INTEKCORE is the ELIMFILTERS air-cleaner housing and sealing architecture for controlled airflow and bypass prevention.
canonical.systems: Air Intake & Airflow Protection; engine air-cleaner housing and element-retention architecture.
canonical.failure_impact: Inadequate housing integrity, element fit or seal loading can create an unfiltered-air ingress path that bypasses the intended filtration boundary and exposes protected engine components to airborne contamination.
canonical.related_standards: ISO 5011 provides relevant air-cleaner performance test methods for approved intake applications; the technology name alone does not imply a universal performance or certification claim.
canonical.related_technologies: MACROCORE: Engine-air filtration architecture used for primary and secondary intake protection. INTEKCORE governs the housing, retention and sealing boundary; MACROCORE governs the filtration layer. SYNTAPORE is a fuel technology and is not an INTEKCORE air-media variant.
canonical.industrial_role: INTEKCORE provides the housing and sealing layer of ELIMFILTERS Air Intake & Airflow Protection. Reliable sealing and airflow management support intake-system performance by reducing unfiltered-air ingress risk.

canonical.definition: MACROCORE is the ELIMFILTERS engine air filtration architecture for primary and secondary intake protection.
canonical.failure_impact: Inadequate intake contamination control can expose cylinders, piston rings, turbochargers and other protected engine components to airborne particulate contamination.
canonical.related_standards: ISO 5011: Air-cleaner performance testing relevant to approved engine air-filtration applications.
canonical.related_technologies: INTEKCORE: Air-cleaner housing and sealing architecture used to preserve the protected intake boundary and support controlled airflow.
canonical.industrial_role: MACROCORE provides the engine-air filtration layer of ELIMFILTERS Air Intake & Airflow Protection. Media configuration, sealing integrity, airflow management and service interval must be matched to the intended intake duty cycle and contamination load.

canonical.definition: MICROKAPPA is the ELIMFILTERS cabin-air protection architecture for particulate and selected gaseous-contaminant control.
canonical.systems: Air Intake & Airflow Protection; operator cabin HVAC filtration.
canonical.failure_impact: Inadequate cabin-air filtration can increase operator exposure to airborne particulate contamination and can reduce HVAC air-quality performance in demanding operating environments.
canonical.related_standards: Applicable cabin-air test standards and occupational requirements must be matched to the approved application and filtration configuration; no universal certification or efficiency claim is implied by the technology name alone.
canonical.related_technologies: MACROCORE: Engine-air filtration architecture for primary and secondary engine intake protection. INTEKCORE: Air-cleaner housing and sealing architecture for the protected engine-intake boundary. These technologies protect different air pathways and must not be represented as cabin-air substitutes.
canonical.industrial_role: MICROKAPPA provides the operator-environment filtration layer of ELIMFILTERS Air Intake & Airflow Protection. Media selection is governed by the operating environment, exposure requirement, airflow demand and HVAC pressure-drop constraints.

canonical.definition: NANOFORCE is the ELIMFILTERS hydraulic filtration architecture for contamination control in fluid-power systems.
canonical.systems: Hydraulic Protection; approved hydraulic fluid-power filtration applications.
canonical.failure_impact: Uncontrolled hydraulic-fluid contamination can accelerate wear, contribute to valve stiction and reduce the precision and reliability of fluid-power components.
canonical.related_standards: ISO 16889 provides a recognized multi-pass test method for hydraulic filter performance. ISO 4406 provides a recognized fluid-cleanliness coding framework. Application-specific targets and performance values must be established from approved engineering requirements; the technology name alone does not imply a universal Beta ratio or cleanliness code.
canonical.related_technologies: SYNTRAX is the ELIMFILTERS lubrication technology and must not be represented as a NANOFORCE stage. HYDROCORE is a fuel-separation technology and must not be represented as a hydraulic technology.
canonical.industrial_role: NANOFORCE provides the hydraulic-fluid contamination-control layer of ELIMFILTERS Hydraulic Protection. Selection is governed by the cleanliness requirement of the most sensitive component together with system flow, pressure, temperature, contaminant load and duty cycle.

canonical.definition: SYNTAPORE is the ELIMFILTERS diesel-fuel filtration architecture for primary, secondary and cartridge fuel-filter applications.
canonical.systems: Fuel Cleanliness Protection; approved diesel-fuel filtration applications.
canonical.failure_impact: Uncontrolled particulate contamination in diesel fuel can increase contamination exposure at pumps, injectors and other precision fuel-system components.
canonical.related_standards: Applicable fuel-filter test methods and application requirements must be selected for the approved system. The technology name alone does not imply a universal micron rating, efficiency, capacity or certification claim.
canonical.related_technologies: HYDROCORE: Standard non-turbine fuel/water separator architecture, including drain and transparent-bowl configurations. TURBOCORE: Turbine-style fuel/water separation exclusively for FH and FG series systems. SYNTAPORE governs plain staged diesel-fuel particulate filtration only.
canonical.industrial_role: SYNTAPORE provides the staged particulate-contamination control layer of ELIMFILTERS Fuel Cleanliness Protection. Selection is governed by the required filtration stage, efficiency, capacity, flow, pressure drop and protected fuel-system components.

canonical.definition: SYNTRAX is the ELIMFILTERS lubrication filtration architecture for controlling wear debris and lubricant contamination.
canonical.systems: Lubrication Protection; approved engine and equipment lubricant filtration applications.
canonical.failure_impact: Uncontrolled lubricant contamination can accelerate wear of bearings, journals and other lubricated components and can reduce the stability of the protected lubrication system across the service interval.
canonical.related_standards: Applicable cleanliness and filter-performance standards must be selected for the approved lubricant system and application. The technology name alone does not imply a universal cleanliness code, Beta ratio, service-life extension or certification claim.
canonical.related_technologies: NANOFORCE protects hydraulic fluid-power systems and must not be represented as an auxiliary or polishing stage of SYNTRAX unless an approved application explicitly establishes that relationship.
canonical.industrial_role: SYNTRAX provides the lubricant-contamination control layer of ELIMFILTERS Lubrication Protection. Filtration performance and service interval are matched to engine duty, lubricant condition, contaminant load and the requirements of the protected components.

canonical.definition: THERMACORE is the ELIMFILTERS cooling-system protection architecture for coolant cleanliness and component protection.
canonical.systems: Cooling System Protection; approved engine and equipment coolant-filtration applications.
canonical.failure_impact: Poor coolant condition or uncontrolled cooling-system contamination can affect passages, seals, heat-transfer surfaces and other protected cooling-system components, reducing thermal-system stability and reliability.
canonical.related_standards: Applicable coolant, engine and maintenance requirements must be selected for the approved application. The technology name alone does not imply a universal cleanliness code, chemistry specification or certification claim.
canonical.related_technologies: THERMACORE is the canonical ELIMFILTERS cooling technology. SYNTRAX governs lubrication protection, NANOFORCE governs hydraulic protection, SYNTAPORE governs particulate fuel filtration and HYDROCORE governs fuel/water separation including approved turbine-style FH/FG architecture; these technologies protect separate system domains.
canonical.industrial_role: THERMACORE provides the coolant-cleanliness and component-protection layer of ELIMFILTERS Cooling System Protection. Selection is governed by engine requirements, coolant chemistry, filter capacity, system flow and service interval.

citation.concept: TURBOCORE FH and FG Turbine Fuel Water Separation Technology

canonical.definition: TURBOCORE is the ELIMFILTERS turbine-style fuel/water separation technology exclusively for FH and FG series systems.
canonical.systems:
Fuel Cleanliness Protection; approved FH and FG turbine-style separator systems only.

PRODUCTS
FUEL_TURBINE family: 900FH, 902FH, 1000FH, 1002FH turbine housings; 2010/2020/2040 PM/SM/TM replacement elements; Fleetguard fuel processor housings.

BOUNDARY
TURBOCORE must not be assigned to standard non-turbine separator filters. HYDROCORE must not be assigned to FH or FG turbine systems.
canonical.related_technologies:
SYNTAPORE governs plain fuel filtration. HYDROCORE governs approved standard non-turbine fuel/water separators, including drain and transparent-bowl configurations.

FUEL_TURBINE: Turbine Series FH/FG housings and 2010/2020/2040 replacement elements governed by TURBOCORE�.
canonical.industrial_role: TURBOCORE provides the turbine-style fuel/water separation layer for approved FH and FG series systems within ELIMFILTERS Fuel Cleanliness Protection.
